title: Opening a personal view sometimes writes the default view's filter and sort into the address bar, and a reload or a shared link then applies them
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「缺陷 2-7 立卡」 (2026-11-04).

Filed by the record-page epic seat from a browser evaluation of the Console on `main` `63b86b385d` (example CRM, zh-CN, dev admin). An independent reviewer ran the pass and the seat re-checked the evidence named below. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

A rep has narrowed 全部商机 and also keeps a saved personal view. Opening that view directly sometimes puts the other view's conditions into the URL. The list looks right at that moment. If the rep reloads or sends the link to a colleague, the view opens with conditions nobody chose for it and reads 已个性化. The rep has no way to see where they came from.

## Reproduce

1. On 全部商机 set a filter and a sort, so they are stored for that view.
2. Save any personal view on the same object.
3. Load `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity/view/{personal view id}` directly, several times.

Measured by the seat: 2 of 6 hard loads ended with the default view's conditions in the URL, for example `uf__filter` holding `stage not_in closed_won, closed_lost` plus `uf__sort`. The other 4 stayed clean. In a polluted load the list request carried only the personal view's own `close_date between 2026-11-01, 2026-11-30`, and no badge or marker showed. Loading that polluted URL made the same view show a filter badge and 已个性化.

The evaluation shared one account across two agents, so another agent wrote the stored filter. The stored value is an ordinary per-view preference on `crm_opportunity.all`; the defect is that it reached a different view.

## Likely cause (a reading, not yet proved)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:655-656`: until the reader's own views arrive, `activeViewId` falls back to the default view, so `activeView` is the default view.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListUrlState.ts:174`: once preferences are ready, the seed is taken for that list identity from its stored state.
- The effect after it (keyed on `listIdentityKey` and `listPrefs.ready`) writes that seed to the URL, once per identity. When the personal view then resolves, its own seed may compare against `searchParams` from before the first write lands, find nothing to do, and leave the first write in place.

The timing depends on which of the two reads lands first, which fits a result that appears only sometimes.

## Acceptance

1. While a requested view is still being resolved, no other view's stored state is seeded or written to the URL.
2. A test with the personal views read landing after the preferences read, and with the reverse order, ends with a clean URL both ways.
3. A personal view opened by URL shows only its own conditions on every load.
4. A link carrying `uf_*` params that the reader did send keeps working as today.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "awaitingPersonalViews" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`
